# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 25 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## NDR 2026: Public Housing Income Ceilings Raised

- **BTO income ceiling raised to S$16,000; EC ceiling raised to S$18,000** - Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced at the National Day Rally on 23 August 2026 that the BTO income ceiling for families rises to S$16,000 (singles to S$8,000) and the EC ceiling climbs to S$18,000, effective from 24 August 2026. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-raises-income-ceiling-to-16k-and-ec-ceiling-to-18k/)

## HDB Resale Market: Record Transactions

- **Bishan 4-room flat becomes first of its type to hit S$1.3M** - A 4-room HDB resale flat in Bishan changed hands for S$1.3 million in August 2026, setting a new town record for the flat type at approximately S$1,271 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-4-room-hdb-records-first-1-3m-natura-loft/)

- **58-year-old HDB terrace house in Queenstown sells for S$1.04M** - A rare HDB terrace house along Stirling Road set a new record as the most expensive 3-room flat by absolute price in Queenstown at S$1.04 million, despite having around 40 years of lease remaining. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/58-year-old-hdb-terrace-house-in-queenstown-sells-for-record-s1-04m/)

- **18,425 HDB flats reaching MOP in 2026 across 22 projects** - Analysis of 22 HDB projects reaching MOP this year identifies which towns offer the most 5-room and 2-room options and where resale prices remain competitive among the newly eligible flats. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/18425-hdb-flats-could-reach-mop-2026-where-buyers-will-have-most-choice/)

## Rental Market & Supply Pipeline

- **Condo rental prices and volumes both hit all-time highs in July 2026** - Singapore's condo rental market recorded its highest-ever levels for both rental prices and transaction volumes in July 2026, with the HDB rental market also strengthening over the same period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-prices-volumes-record-high-july-2026/)

- **Up to 2,550 private homes proposed for Kallang Distripark** - URA published proposed Master Plan amendments on 14 August 2026 that could transform the existing Kallang Distripark industrial site into a private housing precinct of up to 2,550 homes near Geylang Bahru MRT station. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/kallang-distripark-redevelopment-private-homes/)
